summary.name: edX MicroMasters Programs
summary.one_liner: edX's catalog page for MicroMasters programs, fully online graduate-level course sequences from partner universities that can earn college credit toward a master's degree.
use_cases: Earn graduate-level credits while working full time
Explore whether graduate study fits your career goals
Reduce time and cost toward a master's degree
Provide employee upskilling and education benefits
summary.what_it_does: The page describes edX's MicroMasters programs, which combine graduate-level online coursework aimed at career-ready skills in areas such as artificial intelligence, computer science, data analysis, and business. Learners earn a certificate on completion and may apply to universities that offer credit pathways for certain degree programs. The programs are delivered fully online and are meant to be taken at the learner's own pace. The page names partner schools including UC San Diego, Georgia Tech, and the University of Cambridge, and mentions Harvard, Columbia, and the University of Pennsylvania in its description. It also lists an organizational option for tailored workforce programs.
notable: Certificate may count toward a master's degree at participating universities
Subject catalog includes Artificial Intelligence, Data Analysis, Computer Science, and more
caveats: Credit transfer and master's acceleration apply only if accepted by participating universities
Pricing and enrollment costs are not stated on this page
